children: Overview
China clinical research firm's interim revenue grew 14% yr/yr for six months ended June 2026
Company reported RMB 413.2 mln net loss, with EPS turning negative for the period
Gross profit margin declined to 27.5% from 30.1% yr/yr
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the upcoming quarter or full year in the press release
Result Drivers
CLINICAL DEMAND RECOVERY – Revenue growth was supported by recovering domestic innovative-drug demand and rapid overseas clinical operations growth
PRICING AND STAFFING PRESSURE – CTS margin fell as lower prices on executed domestic orders reduced revenue against similar costs while the company retained and expanded teams
INDUSTRY CONSOLIDATION - Co said ongoing consolidation among smaller CROs and integration in the clinical research outsourcing industry led to increased competition
PIPELINE MISMATCH - Co noted that earlier-stage R&D pipelines have become mismatched with the current phase of the industry, impacting order backlog

Analyst Coverage

Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Hangzhou Tigermed Consulting Co Ltd is HK$53.90, about 32.2% above its August 27 closing price of HK$40.76
The stock recently traded at 31 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 29 three months ago
